thag10.5:1.1: Nānākulamalasampuṇṇo mahāukkārasambhavo candanikaṃ va paripakkaṃ mahāgaṇḍo mahāvaṇo || ||
thag10.5:2.1: pubbaruhirasampuṇṇo gūthakūpe nigāḷhiko āpopaggharaṇī kāyo sadā sandati pūtikaṃ. || ||
thag10.5:4.1: aṭṭhisaṃghāṭaghaṭito nhārusuttanibandhano nekesaṃ saṃgatibhāvā kappeti iriyāpathaṃ. || ||
thag10.5:5.1: dhuvappayāto maraṇassa Maccurājassa santike, idh' eva chaḍḍayitvāna yenakāmaṃgamo naro. || ||
thag10.5:6.1: avijjāya nivuto kāyo, catuganthena ganthito, oghasaṃsīdano kāyo, anusayajālamotthato,|| ||
thag10.5:7.1: pañcanīvaraṇe yutto, vitakkena samappito, taṇhāmūlenānugato, mohacchadanachādito: || ||
thag10.5:8.1: evāyaṃ vattatī kāyo kammayantena yantito. sampatti ca vipatyantā, nānābhavo vipajjati. || ||
thag10.5:9.1: ye 'maṃ kāyaṃ mamāyanti andhabālā puthujjanā, vaḍḍhenti kaṭasiṃ ghoraṃ, ādiyanti punabbhavaṃ. || ||
thag10.5:10.1: ye 'maṃ kāyaṃ vivajjenti gūthalittaṃ va pannagaṃ, bhavamūlaṃ vamitvāna parinibbissanty anāsavā 'ti. || || Kappo thero.
